name: FLORES-101
description: FLORES-101 is a high-quality multilingual machine translation evaluation benchmark of 3,001 English Wikipedia-sourced sentences professionally translated into 101 languages, with rich metadata (URLs, domains, hyperlink/image flags, sub-topics) and multilingual alignment enabling many-to-many evaluation across 10,100 directions. Content is sampled from WikiNews, Wikijunior, and Wikivoyage, with balanced paragraph positions and manual sub-topic labels; translations underwent rigorous automatic checks and independent human quality assurance, achieving ≥90% human-rated quality per language.
inLanguage: 101 languages (including English) spanning families such as Indo-European, Afro-Asiatic, Austronesian, Uralic, Turkic, Sino-Tibetan+Kra-Dai, Dravidian, Bantu, Nilotic+Other AC, Kartvelian, Koreanic, Japonic, etc.
citeAs: Goyal, N., Gao, C., Chaudhary, V., Chen, P.-J., Wenzek, G., Ju, D., Krishnan, S., Ranzato, M., Guzmán, F., & Fan, A. (2021). The FLORES-101 Evaluation Benchmark for Low-Resource and Multilingual Machine Translation. arXiv:2106.03193

rai:responsibleAIMetadata.rai:dataCollection: 3,001 contiguous-sentence segments were sampled from English Wikipedia sources (WikiNews, Wikijunior, Wikivoyage), balancing paragraph positions across articles; each sentence was manually assigned a sub-topic and metadata (URL, domain, hyperlinks, images). Professional translators from selected Language Service Providers produced translations for 101 target languages following guidelines; automatic checks (language ID, copy/source checks, fluency via LM, similarity vs commercial MT outputs with SPM-BLEU heuristics) filtered issues before independent human evaluation and iterative re-translation until a ≥90% translation quality score was reached.
rai:responsibleAIMetadata.rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: Professional Language Service Providers (LSPs) with independent LSPs for translation and QA; no crowd platform specified
rai:responsibleAIMetadata.rai:dataUseCases: Intended for evaluation of low-resource and multilingual MT, including many-to-many translation (10,100 directions), English↔X and X↔Y evaluations, document-level translation (contiguous segments + URLs), multimodal MT (image flags), and ancillary tasks such as sentence/document classification, language identification, and multilingual domain adaptation; also used to validate a unified spBLEU metric.
rai:responsibleAIMetadata.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Content is from publicly available Wikipedia/Wikinews/Wikivoyage articles and includes general topics (e.g., travel, science, politics); no specific handling of personal or sensitive data is described, and no collection of personal identifiers from individuals is indicated.
